prompt: packages/japanese/prompts/reading-validator.md, applied per item: read the passage alone, then mark each option CORRECT / WRONG / UNCERTAIN; exactly one option in CORRECT or UNCERTAIN is PASS, two or more is AMBIGUOUS, none is UNANSWERABLE. Strict on AMBIGUOUS: two nouns completing the same compound or the same particle-frame is a reject even when one fits better.
note: Round A, judge family 1 over the 24-row N2 短文 batch (.cache/judge/tanbun-n2.md, keys withheld). All 24 rows PASS on exactly one option. prompt: same 24 items, deliberately different procedure: first answer as a test-taker, then switch sides and build the strongest case the page alone allows for each of the other three options, and report every option that survives that argument.

prompt: same 20 items, deliberately different procedure: for every option quote the exact span of the passage that decides it, or NONE; TRUE requires a quote, an option with no deciding span is UNSUPPORTED. Packet: .cache/judge/tanbun-n2-keys-withheld.md, verdicts: .cache/judge/tanbun-n2-B.md
note: Round A, pass B over the same batch. 17 PASS, 2 AMBIGUOUS, 1 UNANSWERABLE, and the 17 passes again chose the shipped key. n2s-7 was AMBIGUOUS because option 3 restated the printed 十一店 fact, which a quote test cannot drop when the stem asks for 筆者の考え, and option 1 was an unprinted 規制の話. n2s-19 was AMBIGUOUS because its key called the printed 正午から午後一時 a 午前の部, a span the passage never divides. n2s-14 was reported UNANSWERABLE because its key blamed the 毎月十件未満 condition for restoring the count, which the passage makes the remedy rather than the cause, and no option carried the printed cause. The three rows are burned here and their replacements ship as n2s-21, n2s-22 and n2s-23, re-certified below. The report's own table wrote PASS on the n2s-14 row while its totals line wrote UNANSWERABLE; the row note explains the key option as FALSE, which matches the totals, so the totals are what this record counts.
